historical_references.reference: Kartik is the name of a lunar month in the Hindu calendar and is one of the two months (the other being Shravana) dedicated to Lord Krishna.
historical_references.time_period: This tradition is believed to date back to ancient India, likely before the Common Era.
historical_references.context: During this month, devotees of Lord Krishna observe various rituals and fasts in his honor.

historical_references.reference: Kartik Masi is a significant festival celebrated during the lunar month of Kartik, especially in the northern parts of India. It commemorates the day when Lord Vishnu killed the demon king, Mahisasura.
historical_references.time_period: This festival is believed to have originated around the 10th or 11th century CE.
historical_references.context: During this festival, devotees undertake various religious practices, including fasting, chanting of mantras, and visiting temples.
